formation_passage.locator: Wells 2015, Appendix II, ‘Doubled Signs’, printed pp. 128–129; held text lines 3691–3704 (heading line 3691)
formation_passage.verbatim: Signs can appear sometimes doubled. For example, sign 090 is doubled to form sign 091 and sign 820 doubles to form sign 821. Double signs are not coded in the inscriptions as a pair of the single sign (i.e. 090-090), but are treated as a new sign.
formation_passage.verbatim_second: The second example is sign 820, a typically in the initial position. The doubled sign 821 is still often initial, but also frequently in late medial or terminal position.
